verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair axis for an AI inference cloud, but the evidence documents no cron, scheduler, or recurring-workflow feature. The flex service tier for 'asynchronous workloads' is a one-off, lower-priority request mode, not a recurring schedule. Renting SSH-accessible GPU clusters to 'run whatever you want' would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
